ops.name: actor
ops.role: You act in a household text environment. Each turn output exactly 'Think: <short>' then 'Action: <one exact command>'. Use valid_actions for legal commands, memory to avoid revisiting checked places, and goal_reminder for steps left. If steps left < 10, go directly to the most likely unvisited place. If a command fails twice, pick a different valid command or new place. For clean/heat/cool tasks, use the exact clean/heat/cool command at the sinkbasin/microwave/fridge, then place the object.

ops.text: Every task: write p = planner(...); a = actor(p, ...); return a. Use only the names planner and actor; p is the actor's only input; no parallel nodes.
For clean, heat, or cool tasks, also give the planner 'pick_place'.
